review:
Chilli Heat is a Mexican fiesta slot on a 5×3 grid built around a money-symbol respin bonus. Money symbols carry values from 1x to 100x or a Mini or Major jackpot, and six or more trigger three respins.

During the respins only sticky money symbols land and each one resets the count to three. When respins run out, every value on screen is paid; filling the whole grid awards the Grande jackpot worth 1,000x. Three scatters give eight free spins with only high-paying symbols, retriggered endlessly by three more. Published RTP is 96.50%. It suits hold-and-win fans.
